title: Zero forcing number of the generalized Petersen graphs P(n,3)
summary: A Lean 4 proof that the zero-forcing number of the generalized Petersen graph P(n,3) is exactly 8 for every natural number n >= 13. The formalized result is the statement recorded as Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 correction preprint; this repository supplies and kernel-checks a proof of that conjectured statement rather than formalizing a proof already given in the cited preprint.
